2026-07-21.content:
To provide long-term security and address threats from future quantum computers,
Binary Authorization supports keys that use post-quantum cryptography (PQC)
algorithms. These algorithms, such as `ML-DSA-65` (Dilithium3), are standardized
to be resistant to attacks from both classical and quantum computers. To learn how
to generate a PQC key pair and create an attestor, see
[Create post-quantum cryptography (PQC) keys](https://docs.cloud.google.com/binary-authorization/docs/creating-attestors-cli#pqc-keys).

summary.title: Binary Authorization adds post-quantum cryptography support
summary.summary: Binary Authorization now supports keys using post-quantum cryptography (PQC) algorithms, like ML-DSA-65. This enhances long-term security against future quantum computer threats by using algorithms resistant to both classical and quantum attacks. Learn more about generating PQC keys and creating attestors.
